Title: Property Visibility
Description: Hide properties, groups and tabs per site in the Umbraco backoffice. Rules are keyed by document type or element type, live in appsettings or a JSON file that reloads without a restart, apply to documents and to blocks, and are checked by a health check. Hiding changes what editors see, not what they may do: hidden values are still saved and still available through the Management API and the Delivery API.

Screenshots.Caption: One document type on two sites: the Seo tab, the banner image and the related links only where they are needed
Blocks follow the site of the document that holds them: the promo banner's overlay colour is hidden on one site only
The health check reports rules that do not resolve, with an issue code and a suggested fix
